about_the_game:
Looking Up is a cozy puzzle game where you play as Emilia, an enthusiastic 7-year-old who sets out on a journey to learn how to fly. Set in a cozy interior, you will explore Emilia’s experiments and belongings to help her learn about flying. With visual puzzle mechanics, players will have the opportunity to solve puzzles and find ways to help her along her journey.

Follow Emilia as she grows up, each page holding a memory close to her heart reminding her how her love for the skies carried her from childhood dreams to the stars above, even as she explores the realities and hardships of flight, experimenting with ever more difficult methods along the way.

Blueroof Games' first product lets players enjoy puzzles in each environment of the notebook, making them think while also immersing them in the magical art style of the studio's debut game.

Features

  • Meditative gameplay 

  • Many unique puzzles.

  • A touching father-daughter story

  • Handcrafted visuals

  • Great for all ages

  • Puzzle difficulty progression

  • Aging with the main character as you explore her story

  • Explore different aspects of flight

  • Simple and accessible controls

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.13 High Sierra or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5 (both supported via Rosetta on Apple Silicon)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 / AMD Radeon / NVIDIA equivalent (Metal support required)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard audio output supported by macOS
  • Additional Notes: Runs on both Intel and Apple Silicon Macs

name: Looking Up

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (8th Gen) or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated sound card
  • VR Support: No
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: Looking Up captures an emotional story between Emilia and her dad. Explore and experience her discovery of flight by solving puzzles which include butterflies, mythical creatures, and birds! Grow up with Emilia and reach the skies!
